_source: Code of Practice for Fire Safety in Buildings 2011 (2024 Edition), Part F (Clauses F1-F7, Appendix F1 Table F1). Checked against the full Code text (fs-code-2011.txt).
status: advisory, except where fire engineering (FSAR) or a BO s.42 modification makes the fire safety management plan a condition (F4.1)

items.approved_gbp_exit_routes: Approved general building plans with the exit routes highlighted
items.fsp_specifications: Documents indicating the details / specifications of the fire safety provisions installed
items.maintenance_periods: Period for regular maintenance of the fire safety provisions installed
items.maintenance_records: Records of maintenance or repair works carried out
items.final_fsar: A copy of the final FSAR, if any

items.staff_duties_fire: Staff duties in case of fire
items.fire_wardens: Fire wardens appointed for managing evacuation
items.drills_and_seminars: Fire drills and fire safety seminars at regular intervals for staff and occupants, including persons with a disability

items.call_999: Procedure to report the fire to FSD (dial 999)
items.inform_and_assist: Inform occupants and assist them to the ultimate place of safety
items.disabled_evacuation: Evacuation procedures for persons with a disability
items.trs_locations: Locations of temporary refuge spaces shown on the evacuation plan (where provided)
items.trs_communication: Management office staff to communicate with persons in temporary refuge spaces and inform firefighters

fire_engineering.bounding_conditions_in_gbp: Bounding Conditions to be included as part of the general building plans
fire_engineering.bounding_conditions_and_fsar_in_fsmp: Bounding Conditions and a copy of the final FSAR included in the FSMP
fire_engineering.bounding_conditions_in_dmc: Bounding Conditions listed in the approved GBP included in the DMC, where applicable

items.smoke_detectors_kept: Smoke detectors inside the flats and at the common lobby not removed or obstructed
items.sprinkler_kept: Sprinkler head above the open kitchen not removed or obstructed
items.fr_wall_kept: Full height wall FRR not less than -/30/30 adjacent to the flat exit door not removed
items.annual_check: Annual check of the above FSI by the management's registered FSI contractor

items.moe_maintained: All means of escape maintained, free from obstruction, signed and lit
items.fr_doors_closed: Fire rated doors along exit routes maintained and kept closed
items.alternative_measures: Alternative measures where MoE, fire doors or fire barriers are temporarily removed
items.combustibles_controlled: Combustible materials in safe custody, not accumulated (Cap. 295)
items.fsd_notified_shutdown: FSD notified of temporary shutdown of FSI
items.first_aid_firefighting_equipment: First-aid and firefighting equipment readily accessible, workers trained
items.emergency_plan: Emergency plan and training for all workers

drill_frequency_months._note: Education Regulation (Cap. 279A) r.38: schools at least once every 6 months, recorded in the school log book. Other uses: 'regular intervals' (F6.3); no fixed period in the Code.

table_F1.1.1: Exit routes free from obstructions at all times
table_F1.1.2: No unauthorized alteration along the exit route
table_F1.1.3: No metal gate or roller shutter across exit routes
table_F1.1.4: Doors / gates in common areas openable from inside without a key
table_F1.1.5: Doors / gates do not swing onto exit routes reducing effective width
table_F1.1.6: Fire rated doors self-closing and kept closed
table_F1.1.7: No combustible linings within exit routes
table_F1.1.8: Adequate lighting of exit routes in good condition
table_F1.1.10: Balustrades and handrails in good condition
table_F1.1.11: Hold-open devices to fire rated doors tested
table_F1.1.12: Temporary refuge spaces free from obstruction
table_F1.1.13: CCTV and intercom for temporary refuge spaces in good condition
table_F1.2.1: Fire rated doors (protected exits, FL lobbies, staircases, plant rooms) in good condition incl. ironmongery and glazing
table_F1.2.2: Fire rated doors and smoke-sealed doors kept closed
table_F1.2.3: Fire rated doors not removed or replaced by lower FRR doors
table_F1.2.4: No unauthorized alteration to fire resisting construction
table_F1.2.5: Fire barriers in good condition, no unprotected openings, FRR maintained
table_F1.2.6: Non-emergency services in required staircases enclosed by fire barriers; access panels closed
table_F1.2.7: No unauthorized openings in protected exits / staircase walls
table_F1.2.8: No penetrations through a fixed light
table_F1.2.10: Vision panels to fire rated doors intact
table_F1.2.11: Penetrations in fire barriers sealed with fire seals / stops
table_F1.2.12: No exhaust fans / A/C units in protected exits
table_F1.2.13: Basement smoke vents not blocked; basement smoke extraction inspected by registered FSI contractor
table_F1.3.1: Access to fireman's lifts unimpeded from the street
table_F1.3.2: Fireman's lift lobby walls in good condition, FRR maintained
table_F1.3.3: EVA free from obstructions and in good condition
table_F1.4.1: No change in Use Classification with fire safety implications
table_F1.4.2: Open kitchens: detectors, sprinkler and fire rated wall intact
table_F1.4.3: Fire safety seminars and fire drills organized regularly
table_F1.4.4: Electrical installations inspected by registered electrical contractors regularly
table_F1.4.5: Fire safety precautionary works during A&A and repair (F5.6 / F5.7)
